title: Chapter 1017
text:
The stargate built by the Black Star Corps was the first choice of countless foreign organizations. It had become the most popular and convenient route in the Flickering World, with countless spaceships passing through it every second.

The reason for this was that the Black Star Corps' territory was very large, including two border Star Systems in different directions. They had built stargates that connected directly, so there was no need for them to go through other territories, saving a lot of time.

Secondly, Han Xiao's familiarity with the star map was showing its effect. In the territory he chose, there were a lot of transportation hubs and strategic locations. It was the most prosperous area in his previous life, and now, it was rapidly regaining its glory. The financial groups that invested in the Black Star Army also began to receive returns. Han Xiao promised to hand over a portion of the businesses in the territory to these investors. Now, there were countless financial groups that stayed in the army's territory to do things, so the business in the army's territory quickly became richer.

More than half of the foreign organizations chose to pass through the Black Star Corps' territory. Of course, Han Xiao would not provide a free service. A large number of spaceships entered the Garu Star Cluster every day, and he collected a lot of toll fees.

The stargate spat out a dense stream of light, forming a blurry silver rainbow that did not dissipate for a long time.

At this time, spaceships with the Black Star logo flew out from the stargate and followed the crowded fleet.

"This is the entrance to the Black Star Corps' territory."

Every battleship carried a large number of army players, and they were all squeezed in front of the porthole with curious expressions.

Planet Black Gate came into view. Compared to the cold and cheerless image that the players had in mind, Planet Black Gate was now bustling with life. Countless spaceships were taking off and landing, and the flow of people was dense. The surface of the planet was endless, and countless lights were like a curtain of jewels covering the planet.

And beside it, there was a silver rainbow hanging diagonally in the universe, extending all the way to the end of the line of sight. This was the trail of hyperdrive flames left behind by countless spaceships passing through. The spaceships flew past like meteors again and again, and because they were so frequent, they did not dissipate. It was like a line that could not be erased was left on a black canvas by a silver colored pen. It ran through the entire stargate route as if it had become a guide.

"Planet Black Gate, the gateway to the Black Star Corps' territory, the landmark of the Garu Star Cluster," Maple Moon softly read the information displayed on the communicator.

"It's so lively. It's completely different from the previous version." Mad Blade could not help but sigh.

Only when he personally arrived at the army's territory did he feel that the changes in the army were like a dream.

Mad Blade was one of the earliest players to follow Black Star. He had experienced every step of the Black Star's rise, and he found it hard to believe that his faction had really developed to this point and had such a vast territory.

Just looking at the size of their territory, it was equivalent to ten Star System Civilizations and could even be compared to some Star Cluster Civilizations. How terrifying.

In his eyes, Black Star's thigh had become thicker again.

Just as his imagination was running wild, Maple Moon softly asked, "The Flickering World is a world server, and we arrived earlier than the players from the other Star Fields. This period of time is very important. Do you have any plans?"

"Don't worry. The guild will first register as a subsidiary organization in the army, and we will follow the guild's orders. We should be able to go to the fourth exploration phase to seize the opportunity," Mad Blade said.

"I didn't expect the army to release such a revolutionary system. This will almost make the guilds independent from the army, and the faction affiliation will become more flexible. The gameplay will be completely reformed. This is of course a good thing for us, but from Black Star's perspective, I don't know what he's thinking. Why is he willing to give up his power?" Maple Moon could not help but mutter. Even after so many days, she was still shocked.

"It means that my previous guess was right. As the overall grade of the players increases, our influence on the universe will become greater. It seems like this version will be the turning point." Mad Blade had an expression that said, 'I'm very smart. Quickly praise me.'

Originally, many players were confused about how to take the lead in the current Flickering World. However, the new system that Han Xiao released not long ago immediately pointed out a clear path for all the army players.

Team Merit Points were practically tailor-made for the development of guilds. Almost every Chinese guild with a name decided to register as an official organization in the army. Similarly, this also set off a trend of building guilds. During this period of time, countless army players called their friends to form guilds. Han Xiao's approach was extremely effective.

The fleet continued forward, flying for a period of time, and arrived at Black Star Palace. This was also the first time that the players saw this new main base built during the version update. Its grand scale made many players gasp in amazement.

The first batch of players to arrive arrived at the outermost ring of the base and gathered in a hall. Phillip had summoned them here for inspection.

Not long after, two figures walked in. All the players present turned to look at them in unison, and their spirits were lifted.

The two of them were Army Commander Han Xiao and the army's second Beyond Grade A, Hella.

"Wow, long time no see. Hella is getting more and more beautiful."

"This face! This figure! This aura! Please let me die here! "

"Save it, it's all nonsense (laughing emoji)."

"Ah, I miss the feeling of being beaten to death by Hella. Maybe this is love."

"No, this is perverted."

"Women? Boring. Only a strong man like Black Star can make you feel so good that you can't breathe. "

A large group of players rushed up to get close to them. The words' I want to gain favorability 'were clearly written on their faces. Hella was surrounded by countless people and was even more popular than Han Xiao.

Han Xiao cursed in his heart for being sexist. Before the impatient Hella started her massacre, he took the initiative to push the people around away, clapped his hands, and said with a deep voice, "Silence, I have something important to say."

Hearing this, the players gradually quieted down. Pairs of curious eyes stared at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao cleared his throat and slowly said, "Now that the Flickering World is open to the outside world, the exploration of the new Star Field has entered a new stage. The peace of the past no longer exists. In the future, there will be countless disputes surrounding the resources of the new Star Field. Our Black Star Corps also needs to adapt to this change.

"I believe everyone already knows that the army has recently issued a new system. This is the first step of change. Everyone here is my hometown and comrade-in-arms, growing together with the army. The Immortals are very important to the army. You've all contributed greatly. I've decided to give you more independence. I hope you can use your talents and make a name for yourselves. "

As soon as he finished speaking, many of the players looked at each other in shock. They were greatly surprised.

This seemed to be the first time Black Star had talked about the Immortals to them.

Before this, although they worked for the Black Star Corps, they did not feel that they were very important. The outside world called them Immortals, but the army commander did not seem to have talked about this in public. He had always treated them like normal members.

In Version 1.0, the Germinal Organization had already studied the players. Until now, there were still similar situations. All the players had always known that their immortality mechanism might arouse the curiosity of the NPCs. However, in the eyes of most people, this was just a method to increase the sense of realism. They did not pay too much attention to it.

However, now that they suddenly heard Black Star say this, the players present had an inexplicable feeling. It was as if something that they had ignored all this time had appeared in their minds again. They were really very unique. In their eyes, Han Xiao's image became even more vivid.

Other than this inexplicable feeling, the players present were also very happy. To be able to hear the faction leader, Black Star, personally admit that they were very important to the army, many of them were very excited. They could not help but have a subtle sense of accomplishment and belonging in their hearts.

Han Xiao looked around, taking in everyone's expressions. He suddenly smiled and said, "Don't be surprised. Although Hella and I are now Beyond Grade As, we're all from the mother planet. In this cold universe, we're all on the same side, so there's no need to be too formal with me. I have high hopes for all of you. Remember, the Black Star Corps will always be behind you."

Hearing this, everyone's spirits were lifted.

Mother planet … That's right, how could I forget this? Black Star has this layer of bond with us.

Seeing Han Xiao's attitude, everyone felt that Han Xiao had become even more amiable.

In the crowd, Maple Moon was deep in thought. She quietly poked Mad Blade's waist and whispered, "Why do I feel that Black Star seems to have changed a little?"

"Change? Haha, you're wrong. He hasn't changed at all! " Mad Blade, however, had an excited expression. "This is the Han Xiao I remember, not that cold big shot Black Star!"

His voice was too loud, and many of the pro players around could not help but look over.

"He's right. How long has it been since Black Star had close contact with us?" Second Prince muttered.

"As Black Star's status became higher and higher, it was difficult for others to come into contact with him. I didn't expect him to still be as down to earth as he was in Version 1.0." Sleepy Winter chuckled. "It seems like he really treats us as his confidants."

Many people discussed softly, but Pork Bun turned a deaf ear to them and focused on recording this scene. His face was filled with joy.

Han Xiao glanced at him discreetly and nodded to himself.

In the previous versions, as his status rose, the opportunities for the players to come into contact with him gradually decreased. After two versions, his image was already a little cold.

However, in Version 4.0, the role of the players would become more and more important. Han Xiao decided to become more down-to-earth and close the distance between him and the players, deepening the emotional bond between him and the players. This was an important factor that influenced the players apart from benefits.

After all, he was a player in his previous life, so how could he not know about the G spot of the players?

Seeing the joy on the players' faces, Han Xiao coughed and spoke again, finally revealing his true intentions.

"The competition in the Flickering World has become very intense. I'm going to mobilize a fleet and head to the fourth exploration phase to compete with the external organizations. You can participate if you want. As long as a member of each registered affiliate organization participates, they will be able to obtain more Team Merit Points based on the number of participants. They will also be allowed to build strongholds on planets in the army's territory and be protected by the army. At the same time, all goods in the Quartermaster Department will be temporarily sold at thirty percent."

As soon as he said that, a faction mission popped up on the interface, and the eyes of the players lit up.

Not only would there be a large faction main storyline mission, but they would also be given a thirty percent discount on the faction store and could even build a proper guild stronghold in the army's territory …

Black Star was indeed still that Black Star. This was the walking benefit!

Seeing that the players could not wait, Han Xiao announced the end of the meeting. The players dispersed and immediately ran to the Quartermaster Department to shop. The money they had accumulated in the previous version was still in their hands, and the wallets of the players were full.

The thirty percent discount was a promotional method to stimulate the players to spend more. Although the players' current mentality was to level up, they would definitely be swayed by such a huge benefit. This was to harvest the experience of the players.

Han Xiao had not been idle in the past twenty years and had accumulated a wave of Mission Completion Cards. He was currently level 307, and he had increased a little during the update. He would be able to advance once he reached level 320.

The few Star Clusters in the fourth exploration phase were where the competition was the most intense. They were also the main stage for the players to fight in the World Server. This was also to urge the players to gain an advantage in the fourth exploration phase to help the army players maintain their lead and prevent them from being bullied by the foreign players.

In addition, letting the guilds that had registered as proper organizations build their guild strongholds in the army's territory was also a form of benefit binding … Their homes were all in his territory, so the cost of leaving the faction would be even higher.

"It's all a trick. I'm really a little naughty …"

Han Xiao shook his head and chuckled.

Leaving the hall with Hella, the two of them strolled around the army and chatted. At this moment, Hella suddenly spoke.

"Black Star, I'm also preparing to go to the fourth exploration phase to participate in the army's exploration at the frontline."

"Are you itching for a fight?" Han Xiao glanced at her.

"Hmm, I'm not you. I can't remotely control my doppelganger at home. I want to spar with more Beyond Grade As, and this is a good opportunity." Hella nodded.

After becoming a Beyond Grade A, she did not slack off at all. She knew that there was still a huge gap between her and Han Xiao, so she still wanted to improve herself.

It was not suitable to spar in the Shattered Star Ring. Now that she was in the Flickering World, it was a good opportunity to train herself.

"Alright, then you'll be the fleet commander. Let me remind you, dozens of Beyond Grade As will be fighting in the fourth phase. For a long time to come, that place will probably be the most dangerous place in the entire universe. If you encounter someone you can't handle, inform me. My doppelganger will follow the fleet at all times," Han Xiao said.

So many Beyond Grade As were not there for sightseeing but to fight for the benefits of the new Star Field. Without Han Xiao's restrictions in the Flickering World, these people would definitely fight fiercely. Not only Hella, but Han Xiao was also preparing to have his doppelganger stay there permanently.

After separating from Hella, Han Xiao walked to his room. Along the way, he opened the player forums and browsed through the movements of the players in the various Star Fields, admiring the elegance and easygoing nature of the idiotic netizens.

After browsing for a while to relax, a new post was pinned at the top.

Han Xiao took a look, and his eyes sparkled. It was the first issue of 'Galaxy Times' since the release of the new version!

"GDX, after waiting for more than half a month, you're finally willing to update?"
